description: The second leg of the dual verdict (D-079): the head's own tooling, run in a checkout of the head (gate_pin.head_tooling) with fresh build and test caches and no carry-over (cold, P-43), the head sha appended; report-only, so it publishes no event, record or pr.ready. Exit 0 is PASSED; anything else, a timeout (train.tier2_timeout_s) or a run that cannot start refuses (fail closed). Measured as train:self-host.
